name: @w6w-apps/wealthbox
description: Manage Wealthbox CRM contacts, tasks, events, opportunities and notes via the Wealthbox API v1.

w6w.longDescription:
Wealthbox is a CRM built for financial advisors, and this app puts its core records into a workflow — list, read, create, update and delete contacts, tasks, events and opportunities, plus list and create notes, and read the users and custom fields a write actually needs to reference. Tasks can be assigned to a user or to a whole team from one action, and opportunity listing excludes closed deals by default so a pipeline view doesn't fill up with old wins and losses.

One inconsistency in Wealthbox's own API is worth knowing before writing against it: updating a contact is a genuine partial patch, but updating a task, event or opportunity is not — Wealthbox requires the same fields the create call does, so moving a deal to a new stage means resending its name, close date, probability and amounts too, not just the one field that changed. This app mirrors that requirement directly rather than assuming one partial-update convention applies everywhere.
